exact_public_reel_covers.observed: cream/sepia paper-like panel; two expressive hand-drawn line characters; backpacks and floor line establish setting; dialogue lives in a speech bubble; rounded vignette; generous negative space
environment is the visual metaphor: blue sky plus brown cliffs; character action carries story; sparse hand-lettered milestone labels are embedded into scenery; muted palette; rounded frame corners
stark white background; black hand-drawn line characters; one dominant central money-pile prop; handwritten dialogue; many small reaction characters; high negative space

transferable_grammar.composition: one visual premise per beat; environment/prop does explanatory work
transferable_grammar.character_style: original simple line characters with bent joints, expressive faces, pose changes and prop contact
transferable_grammar.typography: handwritten or speech-bubble copy integrated into scene; avoid corporate headline-card rhythm
transferable_grammar.pacing: new meaningful pose, prop, camera move, gag or scene every 2-5 seconds
transferable_grammar.density: large negative-space reserve; one dominant focal action and one support element
transferable_grammar.palette: white/cream dominant with restrained muted accent colors
transferable_grammar.transitions: action-led entrances, slides, falls, reveals and object transformations rather than slide-deck cuts
transferable_grammar.originality: do not copy exact characters, backgrounds, poses or wording from references

finance_adaptation.example_math: spend $80, receive $20 credit, net cash outlay $60
finance_adaptation.rule: count only value you would buy anyway; compare that value with the fee actually paid
